title: Speculative Macro Commit for Faster Tool-Using Agents
content:
arXiv:2609.03236v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Tool-using LLM agents spend wall-clock time not only on model inference but also in serial action--observation turns, where each tool call, environment transition, and observation can delay subsequent decisions. We introduce \textbf{Speculative Macro Commit} (SMC), a runtime mechanism for a two-tier agent system: a large authoritative actor model produces the official trajectory, while a faster speculative drafter model continuously predicts and executes future action chains on an isolated environment snapshot. SMC mines recurring multi-action skeletons from training traces and stores them in a macro library used to match against action chains predicted by the drafter at runtime. When the actor's next tool call matches the first drafted action, SMC commits the remaining pre-executed draft steps, together with their observations, to the official trajectory. Using Qwen3.5-27B INT4 as the authoritative actor model and Qwen3.5-4B as the spec
author: Zeyu Liu, Souvik Kundu, Peter A. Beerel
summary_zh: 论文提出 Speculative Macro Commit (SMC)，用「大模型主执行 + 小模型投机预测」的双层架构加速工具调用型 LLM Agent：小模型在隔离的环境快照中提前执行预测的动作链，并从训练轨迹中挖掘可复用的多步动作骨架存入宏库，主模型下一步调用匹配时直接提交结果，从而削减串行的动作—观察等待。对构建 Agent 运行时、优化工具调用延迟有直接借鉴价值。

title: Introducing @huggingface/kernels: 200+ WebGPU Kernels for Local AI
summary_zh: HuggingFace 推出 @huggingface/kernels，提供 200+ 个 WebGPU 内核，让开发者能在浏览器端本地运行 AI 推理，无需服务器或原生依赖。对于构建本地化、隐私优先的 AI 应用和 Web 端 LLM 工作流具有直接的工具集成价值。

title: BenchMIRT: What are LLM benchmarks actually measuring?
summary_zh: 文章借助项目反应理论（IRT）对主流 LLM 基准测试进行再分析，探讨这些榜单究竟在测量模型的哪些潜在能力维度，以及题目难度与区分度如何影响排名。对于理解模型评测的可靠性、避免被单一 benchmark 分数误导、以及为自身场景挑选合适的评估集有参考价值。

title: MasterControl Seventeen Every Time
content:
arXiv:2609.03209v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We study a governed approach to enterprise analytics: a language model interprets the question, while deterministic policy selects and runs a pre-approved analytical program that returns both results and evidence. We show that this restriction can remain expressive within a defined analytical class, using relational operations plus aggregation, comparison, windows, ranking, and similarity. Fixed meaning, policy, data, and execution rules also make results replayable. Across 440 runs, three 8B models generated SQL and selected tools at runtime, while Qwen3-8B interpreted intent only and policy executed the approved program. None of 330 runtime-planning episodes matched the full answer-and-evidence contract across all test datasets; the policy-executed analyzer matched 110 of 110. This is a configuration-specific result, not evidence that runtime agents cannot succeed under other designs.
author: MasterControl AI Lab
summary_zh: 论文提出企业分析场景下的「受治理」LLM 架构：语言模型只负责理解用户意图，实际执行交由确定性策略选择预先审核过的分析程序，同时返回结果与证据。440 次实验显示，让 8B 模型在运行时自由生成 SQL 或选择工具的 330 次尝试无一满足完整的「答案+证据」契约，而策略执行路径可复现。对构建可靠 LLM 工作流有参考价值：把不确定性限制在意图理解层，执行层保持确定性。

title: Fresh Memory, Stale Plans: Dependency-Scoped Validation for Distributed LLM-Agent Memory
content:
arXiv:2609.03340v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Distributed LLM-agent teams can read the latest shared facts and still act on an obsolete plan. A planner may derive an action from requirement $r_3$, another agent may commit $r_4$, and an executor may receive $r_4$ without replacing the plan derived from $r_3$. We call this \emph{stale-plan execution}: state freshness does not establish that the plan authorizing an action remains valid. We introduce PlanFence, a dependency-scoped action-validation protocol. Plans cite the exact public records they used, and an executor validates only the records that can affect the pending external action, replanning once or blocking when validation is incomplete. In 30 controlled live workflows with a post-plan revision, a freshness-only executor acts on the obsolete plan in every task, whereas PlanFence completes all tasks without an invalid action. Controlled replay reveals two conditional boundaries: proactive synchronization yields lower coordinat
author: Evan Chen, Shiqiang Wang, Christopher G. Brinton
summary_zh: 论文指出分布式 LLM 智能体协作中存在「过期计划执行」问题：智能体虽读取到最新共享状态，却仍按旧需求推导出的计划行动。作者提出 PlanFence 协议，要求计划显式引用其依据的公共记录，执行器只校验会影响当前外部动作的依赖记录，校验不完整时触发一次重规划或直接阻断。对构建多智能体工作流的一致性与安全护栏有直接参考价值。

title: A Prompt-Engineering Approach to Develop Scalable, Flexible, and Real-Time Hybrid Micro-Level Personalization in a General Purpose AI Teaching Assistant
content:
arXiv:2609.03402v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) teaching assistants powered by large language models (LLMs) offer scalable educational support but often provide limited personalization. This study presents a prompt-engineering-based framework for personalizing general-purpose LLM/RAG-based AI teaching assistants such as Jill Watson across academic disciplines and courses. The framework adapts responses using six learner-specific dimensions: self-assessment, abstraction preference, verbosity preference, perceptual orientation, information processing style, and level of understanding, yielding 96 distinct learner profiles. Student queries are additionally analyzed using Bloom's Taxonomy to estimate cognitive complexity at the interaction level. Learner attributes and cognitive assessments are encoded in structured prompts that condition the LLM without requiring model retraining. The framework is evaluated through experiments using NLP metrics and a human st
author: Saptarshi Basu, Sandeep Kakar, Ashok Goel
summary_zh: 论文提出一套基于提示工程的个性化框架，为通用 LLM/RAG 教学助手（Jill Watson）注入六个学习者维度（自评、抽象偏好、冗长度偏好、感知取向、信息处理风格、理解水平），组合出 96 种学习者画像，并用布鲁姆分类法在每次交互中评估认知复杂度。核心价值在于展示了如何仅靠提示层实现可扩展、实时的微观个性化，而无需微调模型，对构建多角色自适应 LLM 应用有借鉴意义。
